scope: PC registry and selected block/combat-jump/animation-selection state contracts. Complete selected functions with synthetic state; not the full game context dispatcher or combat implementation.

jump.selection: With falling bit, actionMovement8 selects combatroll_fall181 if present, else any state selects fall5 if present; otherwise use contextAnimation.
jump.fallTransition: When not already falling, contextAnimation!=73 (hoverdown), and movement state in0,1,6,7,9: completed matching nonblending animation either sets falling immediately when global7fc094<=0, or accumulates d2c by dt. With positive threshold reached and distance da0==2000000 or >float32(.35), set falling. Nonmatching/incomplete/blending packet resets d2c.

animationChoice.rule: Select among first3 action slots whose ActionInfo flags include8 and character has a clip. Original registry marks block1/2/3 (26/27/28). None returns0, one repeats if necessary, multiple reject previous animation.
animationChoice.random: Original16-bit recurrence: state=(state*0x24cd+1)&65535; index=state/(floor(65535/count)+1) using integer division. Retry while chosen ID equals object+e10.
animationChoice.writes: On success, chosen ID -> e10 and7aa; return1.

entry.conditions: When not already Block12: cooldown<=0; allowStart && pressed; ground byte281!=0; CInfo[context].flags bit20 clear; runtime+eec bit2 set; at least one incoming bolt/melee/special/part pointer.
entry.failedAnimation: No available block animation makes context=-1.
entry.successfulAnimation: Context=Block12, latch=0. Bolt/part capture chooses timer.3 and clears attacker/stage; special/melee chooses timer.1, stores attacker and its animation ID/successor combo stage. Special sets runtime e20 bit20000000.

timing.latch: Before latch, no waiting attacker stage: timer-=dt; when<=0, latch=1,timer=.2.
timing.attackerWait: Before latch with attacker/stage: retain stage while live/enabled attacker context5 has combo_stage<blocked_stage, or special-mode attacker context38 has matching animation; otherwise clear stage. Timer is unchanged in this stage-check branch.
timing.refresh: After latch, held action with incoming bolt refreshes timer=.2.
timing.release: After latch without refresh/reblock, timer-=dt. Expired released action clears context. NPC Gamorrean-guard branch clears context and sets cooldown1.5.
timing.cooldown: Outside Block12, positive cooldown decreases bydt and returns, including possible small negative overshoot.

comboJump.transition: Set Jump0/movementState2; vy=jump_2_speed. Variant0 selects combojump18 and clears bit2000; nonzero selects flip12 and sets bit2000. Clear context bits10000,9000; set runtime e20 bit100000; zero timer,ground/counter,airborne-input fields; reset animation packet to chosen action. Player objects gain eec bit800.
comboJump.limits: Original no-sound branch used. Selection of an opponent and the BlockCode jump trigger itself were not emulated.

pcHold.callback: 0x428f20, configured by game initializer0x42e160 at global955598
pcHold.behavior: If global7f39e4!=0 && global876580==0 return1. Otherwise game-character+90 bit20000000 can call special action404fa0; successful special action returns0, otherwise return2.
pcHold.special: 404fa0 uses slot50/51 according to character ID; when the slot is enabled, writes Batarang context77, target action144, context bit20000 and companion state. Globals and feature bit retain raw labels; no unsupported gameplay names assigned.
pcHold.startHold: 58e3b0 returns immediately if callback null. Callback result2 clears de4 and clears context. Other results can enter Hold24 with timer.3 if configured context exists and a block animation is available, otherwise context clears.
pcHold.referenceDifference: Pinned Android CanStartHold_Game returns1 unconditionally. PC gate and special path were recovered from original instructions and executed; do not substitute Android behavior.
pcHold.fixture: Hold audio helper executes its original no-sound branch using an unassigned player slot and zero world lookup flag.

contextFlagConsumers.meaning: Use fall animation only if global804c0c configures an ID and the character has that clip.
Context owns requested animation: copy object+7aa to animation packet request+42. Static consumer evidence, complete surrounding animation function not emulated.
Prevents starting a new block through this input gate.

explicitActionBindings.limitations: Bindings feed catalog action text directly to original case-insensitive resolver. Malformed quoting and omitted directives remain catalog/parser questions; a failed binding does not prove the animation asset is absent.

staticWriteInventory.limitations: Mechanical pseudocode assignment inventory for explicit +0x7b5/+0x7aa/+0x42 byte/short writes, limited to functions that mention a context offset. Base-object identity is not proven for every candidate. It is not a control-flow graph, complete alias analysis, proof of reachability or runtime transition log. Dynamic expressions are retained.

limitations: Live target discovery, full input dispatcher, every context state machine, animation playback/blending and hit effects remain outside these bounded tests.
Actual animation availability uses loaded per-character model pointers; synthetic availability matrices prove fallback logic but do not replace the asset/catalog loading investigation.
No original bytecode was patched and no callback implementation was replaced. Synthetic global/object fixtures select bounded original branches.
